summary: Iteration 74 — tested tone-per-reply chips, auto-suggest-on-open, reply favourites CRUD, and the new applicant record Delete endpoint/button. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed (tone_style friendly/firm/brief each return exactly 3 suggestions, 'brief' avg length shorter than 'friendly'; favourites POST/GET/DELETE with persistence verification; record DELETE 200 for a seeded throwaway service_pro, 404 unknown id, 404 unknown category, 401/403 unauthenticated). Frontend (admin login via real /login form -> /admin -> Approvals): tone chips render and regenerate, request payload confirmed tone_style is a valid string ('brief'), not an object; clicking ai-suggestion-0 inserts exact text into message-body-input; favourite-save-btn saves and lists, favourite-insert-<id> inserts, favourite-delete-<id> removes, ai-suggestion-save-0 star adds a favourite (1 -> 2); auto-suggest checkbox persists to localStorage applicantAutoSuggest=1 and auto-populated 3 options on dialog reopen; record-delete-<id> shows the expected confirm prompt and the row disappears after confirm. No Send button was clicked (no live email/SMS sent). All test data cleaned up (0 reply_favourites remaining, throwaway record deleted, autoSuggest reset).

minor.issue: Returns 200 {'success': true} even when the id does not exist (delete_one deleted_count not checked) — no 404 for unknown favourite.
Favourites are global (no admin/user scoping) — every admin/agent sees and can delete every other admin's saved replies. Intentional? worth confirming.

issues: AI replies sometimes include emoji (e.g. '🌴') even for the 'Brief'/'Firm' tone, which may not suit a firm/formal reply — cosmetic only
Dialog is tall; on 1080p the footer Send row sits close to the viewport edge (content scrolls, no blocking issue)

action_items: Optional: return 404 from DELETE /api/admin/reply-favourites/{id} when deleted_count == 0
Optional: scope reply favourites per admin user (created_by) if they should not be shared platform-wide
critical_code_review_comments: ApplicantMessageDialog useEffect depends only on [rec] while calling loadThread/loadFavourites/getSuggestions defined in-render — works today but is an eslint exhaustive-deps hazard; consider useCallback.

admin_delete_record allows category 'users', so the Approvals delete button on the User Accounts tab hard-deletes a real user document with no soft-delete/audit trail. Consider logging an audit entry or blocking 'users' from hard delete.
Tone chips + 'Suggest 3 replies' correctly pass a string tone (verified in the network payload); the previously reported 'click event passed as tone' regression is fixed.
